## Which file do I need?

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.16.1.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.16.1.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.16.1.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |
| Install it like a normal program | **…-Setup.exe** (Windows), **…-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip** or **…-macOS-Intel.zip** (Mac), **…-Linux.tar.gz** |
| Host it on itch.io | **…-web.zip** |

The installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn on first
launch. **PLAYTEST-README.txt** explains how to get past the warning.

Two-player games work between any of these files, as long as both players
use version 0.16.1.

## What's new

- **Quick reference card shows the game's icons.** The card's table and the
  areas table now carry the same icons as the game. A new map legend covers
  entry points, contested and leadership nodes, nodes under pressure, the
  watched, prebunked and framed status icons, coverage outlines, this week's
  orders and the ON AIR tab. Donovia's Show of Force is listed too.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.16 builds.
